metadata.confounding_note: Within the held-out set wrap is structurally tied to b=5 and a>=5 (b=0 never wraps); the strata are descriptive, not independent causal factors.
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Strata are defined from operand values and the arithmetic rule before inspecting outcomes. The exact-interface ceiling is a property of the raw observation history (U's estimator, unchanged) and is kept separate from any train-derived baseline and from AE's reader accuracies. No reader is fit; no rule/length/subgroup is selected from outcomes. Sparse/unique-history estimates are flagged and never interpreted as practical learnability.

classification.rule_note: Descriptive, not an acceptance threshold: a held-out subgroup is treated as materially lower if its exact-interface y_true Bayes ceiling is >=0.15 below the same-population overall ceiling in >=4/5 seeds with per-seed support >=20 (task_side_subgroup_limitation_supported); if every adequately-supported held-out subgroup stays within 0.15 of the overall ceiling the observed reader failure is not explained by an evident loss of raw-interface target identifiability (task_side_limitation_not_indicated); otherwise inconclusive. This cannot identify which reader-side limitation explains AF/AE.
